target: Log transformed reported tornado property-damage estimate
timing_contract: Post-event path and timing diagnostic of reported loss. EF damage-derived scale, casualty counts, narratives, monetary/crop losses excluded from predictors.
calibration: Whole EPISODE_ID groups held; no held-event monetary outcomes. Linked tornado segments within episode remain together.
independent_unit: NOAA EPISODE_ID outbreak groups; nearby episodes may still be correlated or linked across offices. Not individual property samples.
scope_limits: 2025 tornado segments with nonmissing explicit damage. Broad estimates including reported0, not insured claim totals. Maximum width times length is bounding footprint proxy, not actual damaged area. Exposure/building stock and wind speed unavailable; no prospective loss or causal damage law.

exposure.schema: Native schema inspected and source-public aggregate descriptions known; case10 status counts were inspected, not new endpoint NVD-score presence scores. No reserved individual target metric printed.

uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.
